name: Part Time Mafia
source:
The story follows a university student studying veterinary science who moves back to the city for the first time since her parents died. Here she finds herself not just caught up in the underworld of the city, but maybe even a part of it.

[From [url=https://baconsoap.itch.io/part-time-mafia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一名学习兽医学的大学生在父母去世后第一次搬回城市。在这里，她发现自己不仅陷入了城市的地下世界，甚至可能是其中的一部分。

[来自[url=https://baconsoap.itch.io/part-time-mafia]Itch.io[/url]]
